'''Pallas's base camp''' was an underground shelter in the foothills of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kallistas]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Pallas Quintell]] used the camp as his base of operations on the planet, as well as a storage depot and communications center.
